instruction.text: Schiebe die Passivsätze zur richtigen Zeitform.

atoms.b: The exam papers are collected by the teacher.
The batteries were changed last December.
The candles have been lit daily.

instruction.text: Schiebe die Sätze zur richtigen Zeitform.

atoms.b: At school, I will be asked about the homework.
The flowers are going to be sold at the flower shop.
The cat is being stroked gently.

instruction.text: Bringe die Teile der Passivkonstruktion in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.a: Die Hunde wurden gefüttert, bevor Rachel zur Schule ging.
atoms.b: The dogs ((had)) ((been)) ((fed)) before Rachel went to school.

atoms.a: Diese Staffel könnte als die schlechteste von allen fünf angesehen werden!
atoms.b: This season ((might)) ((be)) ((seen)) as the worst out of all five!

atoms.a: Dieses Kleid sollte gekürzt werden, damit es dir besser passt.
atoms.b: This dress ((should)) ((be)) ((shortened)) to fit you better.

instruction.text: Schreibe die Passivform in der gegebenen Zeitform in die Lücke.

atoms.b: On his visits, Micheal ((is_treated)) like family by his friend's parents.

feedback.wrong: Das Passiv im simple present wird gebildet mit am/is/are + past participle.

atoms.b: It tastes bad although my water bottle ((was_cleaned)) this morning.

feedback.wrong: Das Passiv im simple past wird gebildet mit was/were + past participle.

atoms.b: Joey's laptop ((has_been_fixed)) three times in only four months.

feedback.wrong: Das Passiv im present perfect wird gebildet mit have/has been + past participle.

atoms.b: The washing machine ((had_been_turned_on)) before Merlin realised he forgot to add detergent.

feedback.wrong: Das Passiv im past perfect wird gebildet mit had been + past participle.

atoms.b: Her grandmother ((will_be_called)) in by her doctor next.

feedback.wrong: Das Passiv im will future wird gebildet mit will be + past participle.

atoms.b: A playground ((is_going_to_be_built)) in Nova Street next year.

feedback.wrong: Das Passiv im going to future wird gebildet mit am/is/are going to be + past participle.
